work_id.description: Unique primary key for each work/project record.

data_source.description: Origin of dataset record (WEB_SCRAPED_REAL or SYNTHETIC_BENCHMARK).

mp_id.description: Foreign key linking work to standard Member of Parliament identifier.

mp_name.description: Full official name of the Member of Parliament.

house.description: Parliament house (Lok Sabha or Rajya Sabha).

district.description: District name or Implementing District Authority (IDA).

work_description.description: Detailed text description of the recommended work.
work_description.example: Repair and renovation of road from CPWD complex, Ranchi Tikrey Dairyfarm to Fisheries Quarter, Port Blair

work_category.description: Standardized category (Road, Drinking Water, School, Health, etc.).

implementing_agency.description: District executing department or authority name.

contractor_vendor_id.description: Unique vendor identifier assigned to the contractor.

contractor_name.description: Full legal display name of the executing contractor.

is_contractor_blacklisted.description: Binary flag (1 if contractor is blacklisted, else 0).

blacklisted_reason.description: Specific reason if contractor is blacklisted.

is_blacklisted_contractor_anomaly.description: Anomaly flag (1 if work awarded to blacklisted contractor).

estimated_cost.description: Initial cost estimate or recommended amount (INR).

expenditure.description: Total actual expenditure disbursed to date (INR).

financial_progress_percent.description: Percentage ratio of expenditure to sanction (0-100%).

sanction_date.description: Date district authority sanctioned the work (YYYY-MM-DD).

sanction_delay_days.description: Engineered Feature: Days between recommendation and sanction.

completion_delay_days.description: Engineered Feature: Days between expected and actual completion.

cost_overrun_amount.description: Engineered Feature: Excess expenditure over sanctioned amount (INR).

progress_mismatch_gap.description: Engineered Feature: Absolute gap between financial and physical progress %.

category_national_avg_duration_days.description: Benchmark: Standard average completion days for category in India.

project_duration_days.description: Project duration in days from sanction/recommendation to completion.

duration_variance_vs_national_avg_days.description: Engineered Feature: Days variance vs national category average.

duration_to_national_avg_ratio.description: Engineered Feature: Ratio of project duration vs national category average.

is_exceeds_national_avg_duration.description: Binary flag (1 if project duration exceeds national average).

is_excess_duration_anomaly.description: Anomaly flag (1 if project duration ratio >= 1.5x or excess >= 90 days).

synthetic_record.description: Flag indicating if record is synthetically generated (True/False).

synthetic_scenario.description: Synthetic scenario pattern applied (NORMAL, COST_OVERRUN, etc.).

ground_truth_severity.description: Anomaly severity rating (CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, NORMAL).
